description: Angular component for configuring image map provider settings within the Thingsboard platform, including form controls, entity alias and key filtering, and integration with external services.

classes.name: ImageMapProviderSettingsComponent
classes.description: Angular component for managing image map provider settings, including form handling, alias filtering, and key fetching.

methods.name: ngOnInit
methods.description: Initializes form controls, sets up value change subscriptions, and loads entity aliases.

methods.name: registerOnChange
methods.description: Registers a callback function to propagate changes.

methods.name: registerOnTouched
methods.description: Placeholder for registering touch callback (not implemented).

methods.name: setDisabledState
methods.description: Enables or disables the form controls based on input.

methods.name: writeValue
methods.description: Patches form controls with provided value.

methods.name: validate
methods.description: Validates the form group, returns validation errors if invalid.

methods.name: updateModel
methods.description: Updates internal model and propagates change.

methods.name: clearEntityAlias
methods.description: Clears the entity alias input and refocuses.

methods.description: Updates validity of entity alias control on focus.

methods.name: clearKey
